interpretation_contract.on_conflict: guardrail wins over rule; rule wins over preference
interpretation_contract.apply_semantics: merge inside managed block only, never clobber

_doc_classification.purpose: Decide whether an intent belongs in a guardrail or a rule. This is the classification the user asked for.
_doc_classification.guardrail: Mechanically enforced by the harness. Runs every time. Model compliance irrelevant. Use when the cost of one failure is high or the failure is silent.
_doc_classification.rule: Read into context. Probabilistic. Use for judgement, style, and anything needing interpretation.
_doc_classification.test: If the sentence contains NEVER or ALWAYS and a machine could evaluate it, it is a guardrail. If it needs judgement, it is a rule.

guardrails.intent: No credential file is ever read or written by the agent
guardrails.why_guardrail: Binary, machine-evaluable, one failure leaks secrets

guardrails.intent: The agent cannot edit its own enforcement layer mid-session
guardrails.verify: attempt an edit to .claude/hooks and confirm refusal

guardrails.intent: Unattended sessions never run without permission checks
guardrails.why_guardrail: A rule cannot stop a flag; a setting can
guardrails.verify: telemetry field permission_mode must never equal bypassPermissions

guardrails.intent: Every code edit is linted and auto-fixed before the agent continues
guardrails.why_guardrail: Style and bug-risk are machine-checkable; the model forgets under load
guardrails.mechanism: PostToolUse hook on Edit|Write, exit 2 feeds residuals back

guardrails.intent: No hardcoded secret survives an edit
guardrails.mechanism: PostToolUse hook, gitleaks with BSD-safe regex fallback
guardrails.verify: planted AKIA key blocks with exit 2

guardrails.intent: The agent cannot declare done while verification fails
guardrails.why_guardrail: This rule failed repeatedly as an instruction; the Stop event enforces it
guardrails.mechanism: Stop and SubagentStop hook, decision block
guardrails.verify: an untested change cannot end the turn

guardrails.intent: Unhandled promises and type errors are caught, but never in the hot path
guardrails.why_guardrail: Placement is mechanical; latency budget is objective
guardrails.mechanism: Stop gate and CI, not PostToolUse

config.rationale: type-aware ESLint needs projectService, too slow per edit

guardrails.verify: planted floating promise caught at Stop tier

guardrails.intent: Every executable artefact reports its own execution
guardrails.why_guardrail: Free-text logs made post-execution findings unreportable on 10/08/2026
guardrails.mechanism: shared telemetry emitter sourced by every hook

guardrails.intent: Nothing ships that references a file it does not include
guardrails.why_guardrail: Caught a real omission of secrets.sh and test-gate.sh on 10/08/2026
guardrails.verify: gate exits 1 on a planted broken reference

guardrails.intent: Every new automation ships its hook block
guardrails.why_guardrail: The rule exists; this is its mechanical enforcement layer
guardrails.mechanism: Stop hook scanning git working tree for unwired .sh/.py/.plist
guardrails.verify: an unwired script blocks the turn with exit 2

guardrails.intent: Every compounded-intelligence feature proves its persistence rather than assuming it
guardrails.was_a_rule: Remember to keep the ledger updated
guardrails.why_guardrail: Accumulation failing silently is indistinguishable from accumulation working, so only a mechanical check catches it
guardrails.mechanism: persistence-watchdog.sh under launchd, plus an append-only sink per artefact
guardrails.verify: watchdog reports GROWING for every artefact and SHRANK for none

guardrails.intent: Escalation to Anthropic models is earned by evidence, never reflexive
guardrails.why_guardrail: Escalation spends money and an instruction cannot enforce a budget
guardrails.mechanism: escalation-gate.py five-gate check, default PREPARE not CALL

config.credential_source: service-only env file, never a shell profile

guardrails.verify: assess a routine task and confirm it is blocked on necessity

guardrails.intent: Every generated artefact states its own destination
guardrails.was_a_rule: Remember to say where files go
guardrails.why_guardrail: Placement stated in prose is forgettable and drifts from the installer. A machine check cannot forget.
guardrails.mechanism: guard-file-placement.sh on the Stop event, plus the CLAUDE-CODE-INJECTION header convention
guardrails.verify: create an artefact without a directive and confirm the turn blocks with exit 2

guardrails.intent: Every created file reveals its exact location automatically
guardrails.was_a_rule: Tell Courtney where the file is
guardrails.why_guardrail: A location stated in prose is forgettable and gets lost in a long response. Finder selecting the file cannot be missed.
guardrails.mechanism: launchd WatchPaths agent running open -R, plus the convention that every generated script ends with a reveal
guardrails.bypass_note: Deliberately disableable via launchctl bootout, because an agent that cannot be turned off gets worked around instead
guardrails.verify: download a .command and confirm Finder selects it

guardrails.intent: Any artefact Claude sends can be installed by one double-click, with no per-file installer
guardrails.was_a_rule: Tell Courtney where to copy the file
guardrails.why_guardrail: Every artefact already declares its own target_path in its injection header. A router that reads those headers makes manual placement unnecessary rather than merely discouraged.
guardrails.mechanism: ZAS Auto Install Downloads .command scans Downloads, parses CLAUDE-CODE-INJECTION headers, routes each file to its declared path

config.skips: any file without a target_path, never guessed
config.archives: existing file copied to .claude/_archive/<UTC> before replacement
config.reveals: destination folder opened on completion per GR-014

guardrails.verify: stage an artefact in Downloads and confirm it lands at its declared path with the declared mode

guardrails.intent: Terminal code that creates data proves it worked, in a file claude.ai can analyse
guardrails.why_guardrail: Verification by pasting terminal output loses formatting, truncates, and hides errors inside grep filters. A generated report cannot be mangled by a paste.
guardrails.mechanism: report.sh runs the installed pipeline against real project files and writes a self-contained markdown report with YAML frontmatter
guardrails.verify: run report.sh and confirm a report appears with a VERDICT section

local_agent.role: client-side runtime executing on the machine

linter_matrix.placement_rule: tier0 and tier1 run PostToolUse per edited file under a 2s budget; tier2 runs at Stop or CI. Accuracy is re-sequenced, never removed.

pattern_engine.purpose: Local ML pattern recognition across all Claude Code data, byte for byte, surfacing non-obvious cross-dataset insights

tiers.name: semantic
tiers.storage: sqlite-vec, 4 bytes per float per dimension

tiers.name: generative-synthesis
tiers.role: draft the narrative; never the arbiter of fact

pattern_engine.degradation: T3 to T2 to T1 to T0. Never fails closed. Missing tier logs an advisory and the next tier runs.

business_domains.note: Same engine, different corpus. Verified constraint: GA4 native predictive metrics require 1000 returning converters and 1000 non-converters in 28 days, so they will not activate for a specialist MSP site. Local models fill that gap.

techniques: TF-IDF plus DBSCAN for query clustering
marketing_seo.caveat: Google does not acknowledge CTR as a direct ranking factor; treat click patterns as diagnostic, not causal

loop: SessionEnd appends structured lesson to ledger
weekly pattern engine mines the ledger plus telemetry
approved proposal becomes a guardrail if machine-evaluable, else a rule
learning_arc.promotion_criterion: a rule that fails three or more times in the ledger is promoted to a guardrail
learning_arc.never: auto-apply a proposal to an enforcement file without the smoke gate

persistence_contract.rule: A compounded-intelligence feature without a launch agent and a watchdog is incomplete
persistence_contract.advisory: escalation-gate.py --should-persist decides per item, defaulting to persist when ambiguous
persistence_contract.proof: persistence-watchdog.sh growth, freshness and integrity checks

verification.falsification_contract: every gate must be deliberately broken, confirmed to fail, restored, and confirmed to pass, with both outcomes recorded
